cases.name: Sebo v. American Home Assurance Co.
cases.one_liner: Florida Supreme Court authority applying concurrent-cause analysis where independent covered and excluded perils combined under all-risk property coverage.

cases.name: Fayad v. Clarendon National Insurance Co.
cases.one_liner: Florida Supreme Court authority for all-risk policy interpretation and strict construction of ambiguous exclusionary clauses against the insurer.

notes: Use for the Lee County wind-versus-water allocation issue only after comparing policy language and available damage chronology.

cases.name: Trinidad v. Florida Peninsula Insurance Co.
cases.one_liner: Florida Supreme Court authority addressing replacement-cost scope, including contractor overhead and profit where a general contractor is reasonably likely to be needed.

notes: Use for scope-of-repair and replacement-cost analysis, not as proof of Hurricane Ian facts.
